purpose: Repeat the same frozen 64-source tile/object lineage pilot after one narrowly scoped OpenCV array-layout compatibility repair in the experimental contour helper. Preserve all candidate selection, object identity, detection configuration, morphology thresholds and external-label firewall from B2.

frozen_sample.selection: For each frozen structural cluster 0..15: two closest to cluster-median anomaly score plus two highest anomaly score, src_id tie-break.

unchanged_from_B2: exact pass2 NUMBER == frozen object_id rule
stage_shape_post neighborhood size and radial-profile method

single_allowed_code_repair.old_assumption: cv2.convexityDefects output is always indexable as defects[i,0][3]
single_allowed_code_repair.replacement_semantics: Convert defects to np.asarray, require final dimension size 4, reshape to (-1,4), and sum row[3]/256.0. This yields the same four OpenCV defect fields regardless of an extra singleton dimension.

operational_acceleration.scientific_semantics: Independent tile jobs are unchanged; only wall-clock concurrency changes. Tile outputs and exact-number lineage are validated per tile/source after replay.

predeclared_B3_gates.tile_identity: 64/64 sample rows reconstructed from frozen tile_id
predeclared_B3_gates.detection_chain: At least 95% of distinct required tiles complete pass1+PSFEx+pass2
predeclared_B3_gates.exact_object_id: At least 90% of sample rows recover exact pass2 NUMBER == frozen object_id
predeclared_B3_gates.sky_consistency: At least 90% of exact rows have replay pass2 coordinate <=10 arcsec from frozen S0 coordinate
predeclared_B3_gates.pass2_raw_morphology: At least 95% of exact rows have finite FWHM_IMAGE, ELONGATION and SPREAD_MODEL
predeclared_B3_gates.shape_execution: At least 90% of exact rows finish repaired stage_shape_post with shape_failed=0
predeclared_B3_gates.contour_metric_coverage: Report finite circularity/shape_defect/circle_deviation coverage separately; do not tune contour thresholds to improve it
predeclared_B3_gates.profile_metric_coverage: Report profile_diff and stars_used coverage separately; local reference scarcity is not silently imputed

external_label_firewall.reason: Even a successful 64-source B3 is a measurement pilot. External nuclear/human/geomagnetic/lunar labels remain sealed until a larger/full label-blind pixel-morphology manifest is constructed and frozen.
